text: {"lessons":["Selling a stock just because it has risen can lock in gains, but I should base the decision on its outlook and my overall plan, not the size of the gain alone.","Holding through declines without reviewing why a stock fell can leave me exposed to further losses; I should reassess each position periodically.","A few trades and short-term account changes do not show whether my approach is working, so I should diversify and judge decisions over a longer horizon."]}
